the best management option for L and U switchgrass cytotypes is to adopt single cut system in order to produce high quality biomass for energy production.
L cytotypes, especially the single harvest system, are the most promising for energy production in southern EU.

the most suitable cutting regime is a single harvest in late September or early October, which would allow a high biomass yield, a high quality of biomass and a low ash content, as well as an easy harvest and low harvesting costs.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best management practice is to cut switchgrass only once per year, at the end of the growing season, to allow for the maximum biomass accumulation.
the most suitable switchgrass cytotypes for energy production in southern EU are the L, and that the single harvest system is the best choice in this region.
the two-cut system is only worthwhile when a high quality biomass is required, as for example for biorefinery purposes, or for a very high yield, as for example to produce electricity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of a suitable cytotype is a critical step for the establishment of switchgrass as a bioresource in southern EU, as well as the adoption of the most appropriate agronomic practice.
the use of L cytotypes is preferable for energy purposes, especially when a single harvest is performed.
